title: Creative Basics & Formats
objectives: Identify the 3 major ad formats: Single Image, Video, and Carousel
Master the 3-second hook rule to stop viewers scrolling
Respect the Instagram Reels and Stories safe-zones

blocks.text: Your creative is the most powerful targeting tool you have! A great ad makes the right people stop.

blocks.title: The 3 Big Ad Formats
items: 1. Single Image: High-contrast photos, product shots, or infographics (1:1 square)
2. Short-Form Video: 15-30 second Reels showcasing problem, solution, and offer (9:16 vertical)
3. Carousel: 2-10 swipeable cards, perfect for catalogs or multi-step stories

blocks.title: The Speeding Train Analogy
blocks.text: A user scrolling Instagram is like a speeding express train. If your first 3 seconds don't wave a bright red flag (a bold hook), the train will zoom right past you.
Reels Safe Zone: Keep text and important logos away from the top 15% and bottom 20% where captions, username, and like buttons appear.
Do not make corporate, television-style polished ads. On mobile, authentic videos shot on a phone feel real and outperform fancy productions!

quiz.q: Why is the first 3 seconds of a video ad considered the most crucial part?
options: Meta charges 90% of the cost during the first 3 seconds
It stops the user from scrolling past in their feed
It is the only part with sound enabled
Videos are legally required to end in 3 seconds
quiz.hint: What prevents a user from immediately swiping to the next post?
quiz.explain: The first 3 seconds contains the 'Hook'. If it doesn't grab attention immediately, the user scrolls away.

quiz.q: Which ad format allows a boutique to show 5 different saree designs in one swipeable post?
quiz.hint: Think of an ad that lets you swipe left and right through cards.
quiz.explain: Carousel ads display 2 to 10 swipeable cards, each with its own image, title, and link.

quiz.q: What is the 'Reels Safe Zone' rule for vertical 9:16 video ads?
options: Avoid placing important text at the very top and bottom where platform UI elements overlap
Only use black and white text
quiz.hint: Remember Instagram's like button, caption, and music track overlay.
quiz.explain: Keeping important text in the central 70% ensures icons, captions, and buttons don't block your message.

quiz.q: True or False: Raw, authentic user-generated videos (UGC) shot on a phone often convert better than glossy studio ads.
quiz.hint: What feels more natural and trustworthy on social feeds?
quiz.explain: True! Authentic UGC looks like native friend content rather than an obnoxious sales pitch, boosting CTR.

recap: Hook viewers in the first 3 seconds with a visual or question that stops the scroll.
Respect Reels safe zones and test phone-shot authentic creative alongside clean images.
